Definition: from G2192 (in the sense of taking hold of, i.e. adjoining); successive:--after, following, X morrow, next.
BiblicalUsage: The word hexēs is after, following, next — a small word, used 5 times; Luke and Acts show it in use.
TheologicalSignificance: I take hexēs as it stands — after, following, next — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
RelatedEvents: The Raising of the Widow's Son at Nain
